BARCLAYS SEES TREASURY YIELDS STAYING HIGH

Barclays says growing reliance on price-sensitive private investors could keep long-term U.S. Treasury yields near multi-decade highs.

Private investors now hold about 73% of the Treasury market, up from roughly 50% a decade ago.
